title.zh: IEA《能源与AI》：2030年数据中心用电约945 TWh
title.en: IEA Energy and AI: data-centre electricity about 945 TWh by 2030

summary.zh: IEA 估计2024年数据中心用电约415 TWh（占全球约1.5%），基准情景2030年约945 TWh，2035年约1,200 TWh；AI优化数据中心用电到2030年增长逾四倍。
summary.en: The IEA estimates data-centre use at about 415 TWh in 2024 (about 1.5% of global electricity), about 945 TWh by 2030 and about 1,200 TWh by 2035 in its Base Case; AI-optimised data-centre demand more than quadruples by 2030.

facts.zh: 美国将贡献2030年前数据中心用电增量的近一半，中国次之。
facts.en: The US accounts for almost half of the growth to 2030, with China second.

caveat.zh: 只读了搜索摘要；这是2025年4月的预测，之后是否更新未核实。
caveat.en: Only search summaries were read; this is an April 2025 forecast and later updates were not checked.

next_recovery: Review listed source gaps; do not treat this cutoff as complete historical coverage.
